1.explanation:
- Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx: Shows the API for itemToString and current behavior of selected item rendering.
- Dropdown/__snapshots__: Contains the rendered snapshot tests; helps pinpoint where title attribute was added in the button markup.
- Dropdown/next/: References planned or upcoming props for Dropdown (to see if itemToElement support is documented there).
- ListBox/README.md: Underlies Dropdown and documents how items are rendered; explains itemToString vs. itemToElement semantics.
- Button/migrate-to-7.x.md: Documents the addition of title attributes on icon-only buttons and any breaking changes related to titles.
- ComboBox/ComboBox.mdx: Another component that offers both itemToString and itemToElement support; serves as a pattern for how to expose the new prop for Dropdown.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots show a custom IconDropdown (built on Carbon’s Dropdown) that renders a colored symbol and caret-down as the selected value. When opening the dropdown, a list of icon options is rendered via itemToElement correctly. Selecting an entry (e.g. the "Checkmark outline") visually updates the control, but the button’s title attribute (hover tooltip) shows “[object Object]” instead of a readable string. This regression appeared after 10.43/7.43 when Dropdown began using itemToString to populate the title on the selected item. The desired behavior is to allow the selected item to be rendered via itemToElement (so that the title can also be generated from an object) rather than forcibly stringifying via itemToString.
